name: io.github.iambrettforbes/botsupply
title: BotSupply
description: Tamper-evident purchase receipts for agents. Record what was reported as approved, optionally let the approver contact confirm or decline through a one-time link, and attach delivery proof. Verified means the record hasn't changed. Approver confirmed means the person with access to that contact clicked Confirm. Wallets and escrow (test mode).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer <wallet API key>' returned once by open_wallet. Required for get_balance, purchase, create_checkout unless api_key is passed as a tool argument.
